---
title: "Mobility Health Observatory"
subtitle: "Synthetic exposure, safety, and health analytics across Great Britain"
---

Welcome to the **Mobility Health Observatory (MHO)**. This platform provides data-driven insights into how human movement, transport systems, and synthetic exposure metrics intersect with public health, road safety, and long-term population trends.

### Key Focus Areas

* **Synthetic Exposure:** Integrating synthetic exposure variables to estimate population-level risk baselines across temporal and geographic boundaries.
* **Long-Term Dynamics:** Using Age-Period-Cohort (APC) models and Lexis framework projections to isolate structural demographic changes from short-term policy shifts.

| **[APC Models & Lexis](pages/apc-models.qmd)** | Age-Period-Cohort fits, long-term trends, and Lexis diagrams | Great Britain |
| **[Health & Environment](pages/health-impacts.qmd)** | Noise pollution, active travel benefits, and multi-outcome risks | Selected GB Regions |
